build_checks: Smali assembly and APK resource build

preserved.pin_setup_pair_and_withdrawal_timing: Original 26.14.3 code, with hostname guards mapped to original trusted app origins.

features.gate: Matrix layout, optional invite code, blank opens normally, original host retained, nonblank routes to /home/register?id=code
features.settings: Single row beside existing cleanup row in /home/mine only; existing route-local observer reused; no polling interval
features.configuration_persistence: Private .mint_mod_state/config.json outside original reset target directories; Restore defaults resets mods; uninstall/Android system clear still removes it.
features.credentials: Empty by default; explicit Apply; proxy credentials never enter page config.
features.mines: Existing JDB Mines 9014 history counts and selectable 1..100 rounds, plus wager counter; no gameplay automation.
features.network_policy: 12 captured paths and 4 exact promotional API paths, adapted only to equivalent cdntoos/cdnapiif hosts listed by original app. Native WebView and ServiceWorker interception.
features.before_render_policy: Same two Vue target render vetoes from 26.14.3; same known limitations on app discovery timing.
features.proxy: HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 with credentials; app WebViews and the existing HTML compatibility fetch use local proxy adapter. Native unrelated SDK/API clients are outside this routing.
features.proxy_control: One ongoing foreground-service notification with a stable toggle action ON/OFF; Android notification permission required.

limitations: No runtime or device tests performed; user performs them.
Pre-render guard requires matching Vue structure and cannot retroactively prevent a dialog mounted before discovery.
Manually opened chest eligibility and rewards remain subject to server conditions.
Proxy routing does not cover unrelated native SDK requests or other applications.
Android can suppress/dismiss the notification or stop the service; permanent availability cannot override OS restrictions.
Game overlay depends on existing JDB 9014 path and brteachcor game layout.
